correctness.rationale: For a planar J_n diagram the number of through strands is n-2(number of caps). Products never increase rank; each earlier top cap and bottom cup persists under powers. If rank is unchanged after multiplication, cap/cup sets cannot change, and planarity makes the remaining through strands uniquely increasing, so consecutive powers are equal. Every nonidentity starts rank <=n-2, and a nonstationary step loses at least two ranks: by exponent floor(n/2) stabilization is certain. Rank n-2 diagrams are exactly the one-top-cap one-bottom-cup c_(i,j). Tracing concatenated one-cap diagrams yields k caps at top (i+2t,i+2t+1) and k mirrored bottom cups before K=1+floor(|i-j|/2), and x^(K+1)=x^K. Thus the maximal K=floor(n/2) and exactly 2 even, 6 odd extremizers (n>=4), with n2/3 all idempotent. An independent DSU/Catalan diagram enumerator checked every element of J_n for n=2..8 (2,5,14,42,132,429,1430 respectively), all power stabilization histograms and extremizer counts, not mistaken for the universal induction.

Finite tests through n=8 do not prove the unbounded gluing induction.
